per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced automated keyword notes with bounded CPP pH-sensitivity and CD structure-context mechanism claims and avoided antimicrobial/cytotoxic mechanism overclaims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_6_adjudication: The previous open ticket is closed because the source-review blocker was repaired; remaining database and figure limitations are cautions, not open blocking rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP labels all seven constructs Antimicrobial/Anticancer, but the local primary paper reports CPP uptake/surface-binding and CD data only. Final database status preserves source_conflict for the broad database activity label.
Recovered activity records are HeLa cell uptake/surface-binding ratios from Table 2, not MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity rows.
Figure-only exact plotted values were not fabricated; Table 2 ratios and qualitative figure conclusions were retained as the locally controllable evidence.
